Container.Name: sacdfs
Container.Overview:
sacdfs serves SACD disc images (ISO files) as DSF and WAV files over SMB and NFS, so music servers and players can read them like ordinary albums. The images are mounted read-only and stay untouched.
Unraid's own SMB and NFS services hold ports 445 and 2049, so this container publishes 10445 (SMB) and 12049 (NFS). Without a user name and password the share is open, read-only, to everyone on your network.
Needs the FUSE device and two capabilities (SYS_ADMIN to mount, DAC_READ_SEARCH for NFS), set in Extra Parameters; the container is not privileged. See https://github.com/aclater/sacdfs/blob/main/docs/install/store-apps.md

Config.Name: SACD images
Config.Description: The share that holds your SACD images (ISO files). Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Index cache
Config.Description: sacdfs's index cache: restarts then skip re-reading every image.

Config.Name: SMB port
Config.Description: SMB share. Not 445: Unraid's own SMB service holds that.

Config.Name: NFS port
Config.Description: NFS export. Not 2049: Unraid's own NFS service holds that.

Config.Name: Formats
Config.Description: dsf,wav, dsf or wav. DSF alone for Roon or MPD.

Config.Name: One folder per disc
Config.Description: 1: one folder per disc instead of one per area (stereo, multichannel).

Config.Name: SMB user
Config.Description: User name for the SMB share. Leave empty (with no password) for open, read-only guest access.

Config.Name: NFS clients
Config.Description: Who may mount over NFS: hosts or networks, comma-separated (192.168.1.0/24). NFS has no passwords; empty allows everyone.
